description: PINELLAS COUNTY, Fla. — The Army Corps of Engineers and Pinellas County signed an agreement Friday that ended an 11-year standoff over beach renourishment.The agreement means the corps will now go back to paying for 65% of beach renourishment projects."The Army Corps of Engineers is proud to stand with you today.
